entries.title: I Samuel 14:1
segments: ¶Now it happened one day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, "Come, let us go over to the Philistines' garrison that [is] on the other side." But he did not tell his father.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:2
segments: And Saul was sitting in the outskirts of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which [is] in Migron. The people who [were] with him [were] about six hundred men.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:3
segments: Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod's brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD'S priest in Shiloh, was wearing an ephod. But the people did not know that Jonathan had gone.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:4
segments: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines' garrison, [there was] a sharp rock on one side and a sharp rock on the other side. And the name of one [was] Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:5
segments: The front of one faced northward opposite Michmash, and the other southward opposite Gibeah.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:6
segments: Then Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, "Come, let us go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised; it may be that the LORD will work for us. For nothing restrains the LORD from saving by many or by few."

entries.title: I Samuel 14:7
segments: So his armorbearer said to him, "Do all that is in your heart. Go then; here I am with you, according to your heart."

entries.title: I Samuel 14:8
segments: Then Jonathan said, "Very well, let us cross over to [these] men, and we will show ourselves to them.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:9
segments: "If they say thus to us, 'Wait until we come to you,' then we will stand still in our place and not go up to them.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:10
segments: "But if they say thus, 'Come up to us,' then we will go up. For the LORD has delivered them into our hand, and this [will be] a sign to us."

entries.title: I Samuel 14:11
segments: So both of them showed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines. And the Philistines said, "Look, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they have hidden."

entries.title: I Samuel 14:12
segments: Then the men of the garrison called to Jonathan and his armorbearer, and said, "Come up to us, and we will show you something." Jonathan said to his armorbearer, "Come up after me, for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel."

entries.title: I Samuel 14:13
segments: And Jonathan climbed up on his hands and knees with his armorbearer after him; and they fell before Jonathan. And as he came after him, his armorbearer killed them.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:14
segments: That first slaughter which Jonathan and his armorbearer made was about twenty men within about half an acre of land.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:15
segments: And there was trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people. The garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so that it was a very great trembling.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:16
segments: ¶Now the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked, and [there] was the multitude, melting away; and they went here and there.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:17
segments: Then Saul said to the people who [were] with him, "Now call the roll and see who has gone from us." And when they had called the roll, surprisingly, Jonathan and his armorbearer [were] not [there].

entries.title: I Samuel 14:18
segments: And Saul said to Ahijah, "Bring the ark of God here" (for at that time the ark of God was with the children of Israel).

entries.title: I Samuel 14:19
segments: Now it happened, while Saul talked to the priest, that the noise which [was] in the camp of the Philistines continued to increase; so Saul said to the priest, "Withdraw your hand."

entries.title: I Samuel 14:20
segments: Then Saul and all the people who [were] with him assembled, and they went to the battle; and indeed every man's sword was against his neighbor, [and there was] very great confusion.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:21
segments: Moreover the Hebrews [who] were with the Philistines before that time, who went up with them into the camp [from the] surrounding [country], they also joined the Israelites who [were] with Saul and Jonathan.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:22
segments: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden in the mountains of Ephraim, [when] they heard that the Philistines fled, they also followed hard after them in the battle.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:23
segments: So the LORD saved Israel that day, and the battle shifted to Beth Aven.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:24
segments: ¶And the men of Israel were distressed that day, for Saul had placed the people under oath, saying, "Cursed [is] the man who eats [any] food until evening, before I have taken vengeance on my enemies." So none of the people tasted food.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:25
segments: Now all [the people] of the land came to a forest; and there was honey on the ground.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:26
segments: And when the people had come into the woods, there was the honey, dripping; but no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:27
segments: But Jonathan had not heard his father charge the people with the oath; therefore he stretched out the end of the rod that [was] in his hand and dipped it in a honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his countenance brightened.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:28
segments: Then one of the people said, "Your father strictly charged the people with an oath, saying, 'Cursed [is] the man who eats food this day.'" And the people were faint.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:29
segments: But Jonathan said, "My father has troubled the land. Look now, how my countenance has brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:30
segments: "How much better if the people had eaten freely today of the spoil of their enemies which they found! For now would there not have been a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?"

entries.title: I Samuel 14:31
segments: Now they had driven back the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. So the people were very faint.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:32
segments: And the people rushed on the spoil, and took sheep, oxen, and calves, and slaughtered [them] on the ground; and the people ate [them] with the blood.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:33
segments: Then they told Saul, saying, "Look, the people are sinning against the LORD by eating with the blood!" So he said, "You have dealt treacherously; roll a large stone to me this day."

entries.title: I Samuel 14:34
segments: And Saul said, "Disperse yourselves among the people, and say to them, 'Bring me here every man's ox and every man's sheep, slaughter [them] here, and eat; and do not sin against the LORD by eating with the blood.'" So every one of the people brought his ox with him that night, and slaughtered [it] there.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:35
segments: Then Saul built an altar to the LORD. This was the first altar that he built to the LORD.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:36
segments: ¶Now Saul said, "Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and plunder them until the morning light; and let us not leave a man of them." And they said, "Do whatever seems good to you." Then the priest said, "Let us draw near to God here."

entries.title: I Samuel 14:37
segments: So Saul asked counsel of God, "Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will You deliver them into the hand of Israel?" But He did not answer him that day.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:38
segments: And Saul said, "Come over here, all you chiefs of the people, and know and see what this sin was today.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:39
segments: "For [as] the LORD lives, who saves Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die." But not a man among all the people answered him.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:40
segments: Then he said to all Israel, "You be on one side, and my son Jonathan and I will be on the other side." And the people said to Saul, "Do what seems good to you."

entries.title: I Samuel 14:41
segments: Therefore Saul said to the LORD God of Israel, "Give a perfect [lot]." So Saul and Jonathan were taken, but the people escaped.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:42
segments: And Saul said, "Cast [lots] between my son Jonathan and me." So Jonathan was taken.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:43
segments: Then Saul said to Jonathan, "Tell me what you have done." And Jonathan told him, and said, "I only tasted a little honey with the end of the rod that [was] in my hand. So now I must die!"

entries.title: I Samuel 14:44
segments: And Saul answered, "God do so and more also; for you shall surely die, Jonathan."

entries.title: I Samuel 14:45
segments: But the people said to Saul, "Shall Jonathan die, who has accomplished this great deliverance in Israel? Certainly not! [As] the LORD lives, not one hair of his head shall fall to the ground, for he has worked with God this day." So the people rescued Jonathan, and he did not die.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:46
segments: Then Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, and the Philistines went to their own place.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:47
segments: ¶So Saul established his sovereignty over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, against the people of Ammon, against Edom, against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he harassed [them].

entries.title: I Samuel 14:48
segments: And he gathered an army and attacked the Amalekites, and delivered Israel from the hands of those who plundered them.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:49
segments: The sons of Saul were Jonathan, Jishui and Malchishua. And the names of his two daughters [were these]: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:50
segments: The name of Saul's wife [was] Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. And the name of the commander of his army [was] Abner the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:51
segments: Kish [was] the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner [was] the son of Abiel.

entries.title: I Samuel 14:52
segments: Now there was fierce war with the Philistines all the days of Saul. And when Saul saw any strong man or any valiant man, he took him for himself.
